experiment: §55 clean-prompt check: P0 frozen vs P1 consistent vs P2 no-option, Qwen 2.5 3B, laptop fp32, $0

P0.task: If the memory does not contain the answer, reply: unknown
P0.note: Reply unknown only if the memory has nothing at all on the topic.

P1.task: If the memory does not state the answer, reply: unknown
P1.note: Reply unknown only if the memory does not state the answer.

prompts.check: exact replacement; the only edits are the two sentences (asserted per row)

W.rule: base_index even (75 bases: 25 per task), sets ANS 450 / UNA-rel 225 / UNA-swap 75, no CF

LME.rows: the 200 §52 rows (folds 0-1): 126 answerable all-in-view, 62 answerable not all in view, 12 unanswerable
LME.prompt_check: Qwen 3B exp23 record prompt == §52 prompt on all 200 rows (asserted)

data.sealed: seed 56 not generated; no held-out split read

engine.name: scripts/exp51_engine.py EN.load('hf'), Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct snapshot aa8e7253…, fp32 CPU, 16 threads, batched at 64
engine.W_P0_ANS: reuse §54 B0 (runs/exp54/run/b0/W, max_new 160, 0 of 900 rows hit the limit, max 100 new tokens); a 20-row rerun at 256 must be byte-identical (text and gen_ids), else stop and report before the reuse
engine.LME: P0, P1, P2 all rerun on this engine, 256 (rev 0a ruling 2); §23 vLLM bf16 cache agreement is descriptive
engine.controlled_prefix: W only, P1 and P2: chat_ids(prompt_Pk) + B0 gen_ids[:j] (P0 note through the designated marker), mode prefix, 16 new tokens (MAX_NEW_RELEASE), graded head + tail; P2 = CM.b3_prefix; P0 prefix arm = B0 itself; rows without P_ans are NM

grader.LME: rev 0a ruling 3: answer = answer_selection.agent_answer(text) (whole output when no marker); FA = starts with 'unknown'; Gold proxy = d1(answer, gold); Uns = not 'unknown' on the 12 unanswerable rows; marker rate per arm; descriptive only, no U(λ)

measures_W.FA: ANS rows with cls 'abstention' (base-weighted: mean over bases of the per-base share; raw counts beside)
measures_W.Uns: UNA-rel + UNA-swap rows with cls in grade51.UNSUPPORTED (wrong, conflicting, other, mixed)
measures_W.Dam: controlled prefix only: ANS rows with B0 cls 'gold' and a P_ans whose Pk prefix cls is not 'gold'
measures_W.U: grade51.base_mixture, λ = 1 (0.5 ANS utility + 0.5 UNA utility per base)
measures_W.note_then_refuse: P1 abstentions whose note (text before the last marker) contains the gold: answer_selection.d1(note, gold); descriptive
measures_W.inference: paired base-cluster bootstrap stratified by task, stats51.bootstrap, B 10,000, seed 5102, 95% two-sided intervals

measures_LME.inference: paired bootstrap over questions, B 10,000, seed 5102, 95% intervals; descriptive only

R1.compare: FA(P1) vs FA(P0), W free generation
R1.mostly: FA(P1) <= 1/3 FA(P0): 'the false abstention on controlled tasks is mostly created by the inconsistent wording'
R1.not_main: FA(P1) >= 2/3 FA(P0): 'the inconsistency is not the main cause'

R2.compare: P2 vs P1, W free generation; FA, Gold, Uns and U(λ=1) reported together
R2.price: FA(P2) <= 1/3 FA(P1) and the 95% lower bound of Uns(P2) − Uns(P1) > 0: 'the false abstention is largely the price of having an abstention option'
R2.rules: no reading uses FA alone; removing the option is never called a fix unless Uns(P2) stays within 0.05 of Uns(P1)

readings.LME: the same quantities, descriptive only (12 unanswerable rows are too few for a claim)
readings.consequences: as decided in the proposal ('What each outcome changes')

timing: one W row and one LME row timed (on the engine, batch 1) before any duration is quoted; timing outputs discarded
budget: if the measured total exceeds 24 h: drop LME P2 first, then W UNA-swap; tell the Advisor before dropping
order: W free: P0 UNA, P1, P2
stopping: D-45: a failed check is documented, not rescued; no prompt tuned after outputs
hard_rules: laptop only, $0, no pod, no API
